question: In a scholarship exam, 60% of the paper has been evaluated. A student scored 70% of those marks. To secure 65% overall, the student still needs 110.4 marks. Find the maximum marks.

en.question: In a scholarship exam, 60% of the paper has been evaluated. A student scored 70% of those marks. To secure 65% overall, the student still needs 110.4 marks. Find the maximum marks.
en.explanation:
Marks already secured:
60 x 70 / 100
= 42
Extra marks required:
Required marks gap =
65 - 42
= 23
Maximum marks are:
110.4 x 100 / 23
= 480
Maximum marks = 480

= 71.43
